title: 1961 Kid Ory Storyville Nights
summary: The Verve album of Jelly Roll Morton compositions, with personnel listed.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: 1961, Hollywood, California, Mr. Blakeney recorded with the Kid Ory Orchestra an album entitled Kid Ory, Storyville Nights, Verve Label, 8456. This was a date in which they played all compositions of Jellyroll Martin.

The group was composed of Mr. Blakeney on trumpet; Johnny St. Cyr, Banjo; John Van Epps, piano; Bob McCracken, clarinet; the drummer was unknown; bass a Mr. Boyack (phonetic spelling), the first name unknown, and this was done in 1961.
